title: Tailwise Grooming Salon Credit on a Tailwise Plus Annual Purchase — Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus
content:
**Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus — salon credit.** When a customer on a free tier buys Tailwise Plus Annual, a salon credit — a flat dollar amount — is subtracted from the first-term Plus Annual fee according to the customer's Tailwise Grooming Salon records: whether the customer holds an active grooming pass, and the date of the customer's latest completed grooming visit.

| Active grooming pass | Latest completed visit | Salon credit |
|---|---|---|
| held | at most 60 calendar days before the purchase date | $3.00 |
| held | more than 60 days before the purchase date, or none on record | $1.50 |
| not held | any | none |

**Both sides (hypothetical dates, active pass held, purchase on 30 June).** Latest completed visit on 1 May — 60 days before: $3.00. Latest completed visit on 30 April — 61 days before: $1.50.
